structure: Single PDF, Florida's State Academic Standards for Social Studies 2025 (6A-1.09401, F.A.C.). Front matter (cover, TOC, s.1003.42 statutory introduction, Four Priorities of Civics Education, Six Essential Elements of Geography, coding scheme, e.g./i.e. explanation, K-12 progression table) = u1-u172. Then three parts: 'Standards for Social Studies K-5' (u173; separate Kindergarten, Grade 1-5 sections), 'Social Studies 6-8' (u964; a 'Grades 6-8' band section with African American History and Holocaust Education, SS.68.*, then separate Grade 6, 7, 8 sections), and 'Social Studies Grades 9-12' (u1793; '9-12 Course Overview' then 12 banded courses). Each K-8 grade section opens with a 'In grade N, instructional time will emphasize:' bullet narrative, then subject-strand headings (American History, African American History, Civics and Government, Economics, Financial Literacy, Geography, Holocaust Education, World History, History of Communism). Codes: SS.<grade>.<strand>.<standard>.<benchmark>; grade is K,1-8, '68' (6-8 band) or '912'; strands A, AA, W, HE, HC, CG, E, FL, G, H, P, S. A 'SS.g.X.n' unit is a standard (topic) heading; 'SS.g.X.n.m' is the benchmark number, whose text is a separate unit (side-by-side blocks, x position) and the order of code and text units is often swapped in the extraction. 'Benchmark Clarifications: Clarification 1: ...' blocks (and 'Example:' blocks in HS Financial Literacy / History of Communism) follow the benchmark and are labeled examples. The 9-12 courses (American History, African American History, World History, History of Communism, Holocaust Education, Civics and Government, Economics, Financial Literacy, Geography, Humanities, Psychology, Sociology) are each course-based with grades 9-12 and course = course title; no shared 9-12 skills section exists outside the course overview. Page markers carry the same running header on every page (no grade information), so grade is taken from section headings and codes.

labels.section: Front matter, intro, coding scheme, progression table

issues: u1-u172: Cover, TOC, statutory introduction and coding scheme are document-wide backup (grades 'all'); the K-12 progression table (u149-u170) lost its shaded cells in extraction, only the strand names remain (the C index of each strand cell hints at the first grade, e.g. R7 C7 World History starts at grade 6, R17 C5 Financial Literacy starts at grade 4); labeled backup.
u173, u964, u1793: part dividers ('Standards for Social Studies K-5', 'Social Studies 6-8', 'Social Studies Grades 9-12') labeled backup with the band grades.

u177-u178, u270-u271, u368-u369, u461-u462, u568-u569, u761-u762, u969, u1021-u1022, u1237-u1238, u1466-u1467: 'instructional time will emphasize' narratives labeled examples (content narrative); u968 (local control paragraph for the 6-8 band) labeled backup.

Throughout K-8 and 9-12: benchmark codes (SS.x.y.n.m) and benchmark text are separate side-by-side units and their order is often swapped or the code precedes/follows the wrong text (e.g. u180-u195, u198-u206, u273-u284); all are labeled standards within the same strand, no grade ambiguity results.
u226, u1623: unit mixes the end of a Benchmark Clarification with the next benchmark code (SS.K.CG.2.4, SS.8.CG.2.5); labeled standards (units are not split).

u3294-u3295: 'Clarification 1/2' (SS.912.FL.5.2) lacks the 'Benchmark Clarifications:' lead-in; labeled examples. Several clarification/example blocks continue across pages or are split into continuation units without a marker (e.g. u2060, u2492, u2514-u2515, u3132, u3141, u3214-u3215, u3325-u3326, u3344-u3345, u3485); continuation units are labeled examples with the block they belong to.
u3250, u3289, u3363: source typo 'SS.91.FL.4/5/6' for SS.912.FL.x; treated as 912 (Financial Literacy course).
u3887-u3911 vs u3912: SS.912.P.11 and SS.912.P.12 carry the same title text in the source (memory); labeled as in source, Psychology course.
u970-u1017 (SS.68.AA, SS.68.HE): grades 6-8 band content that the document says is generally taught in grade 8 / grades 6-8 depending on district; labeled grades '6-8', course null.

u1800-u1992 etc.: 9-12 courses are labeled grades 9-12 with the course title as written in the document; the 9-12 Course Overview (u1796-u1799, graduation credits and assessments) is backup 9-12 with no course.
u2715 (SS.912.HC.8.5), u2507-u2508 (HC.3.6-3.7), u2757 etc.: some benchmarks consist only of code+text with no clarification; no extraction problem, noted for completeness.
u1788-u1789, u1129-u1130 and similar: benchmark code and statement text are in one split unit pair (code unit followed by continuation line); labeled standards.
Guide check: state guide row clusters K,1-8,9-12 and listed topics/courses all confirmed; document additionally has a 6-8 band (African American History, Holocaust Education) not tied to one grade.
